subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Grade 2 English Language Arts: Reading Comprehension, Fluency & Informational Craft
overview: Grade 2 English Language Arts immerses students in literary and informational texts, developing close reading comprehension, evidence-based writing, academic vocabulary, and collaborative discourse.
competencies: Read grade-level literary and informational texts with fluency, accuracy, and deep comprehension.
Cite specific textual evidence to substantiate answers, inferences, and central theme analyses.
Write clear, organized opinion, informative, and narrative compositions using standard grammar conventions.
Participate actively in collaborative discussions, expressing ideas clearly and building upon others' contributions.

modules.title: Decoding Multi-Syllable Words & Reading Fluency
modules.description: Decoding words with vowel teams, prefixes, suffixes, and reading with increased comprehension and expression.

topics.title: Vowel Teams & Diphthongs
topics.description: Mastering spelling patterns such as ai/ay, ee/ea, oa/ow, and ou/ow in complex words.

topics.title: Two-Syllable Words & Affixes
topics.description: Dividing words into syllables and recognizing prefixes (un-, re-) and suffixes (-ful, -less).

modules.title: Fables, Folktales & Central Moral Themes
modules.description: Reading fables from around the world, understanding character challenges, and identifying central morals.

topics.title: Fables and Cultural Folktales
topics.description: Comparing traditional stories from different cultures and analyzing character traits.

topics.title: Point of View and Character Voice
topics.description: Acknowledging differences in the points of view of characters in dialogue.

modules.title: Informative Research Writing & Opinion Persuasion
modules.description: Conducting shared research projects, recording facts in graphic organizers, and writing organized multi-sentence essays.

topics.title: Informational Paragraph Structure
topics.description: Writing clear topic sentences, grouped supporting facts, and concluding statements.

topics.title: Opinion Writing with Reasons
topics.description: Stating opinions on books or issues and linking reasons using words like because and also.
